slide.title: Xdebug 3.6: Native Path Mapping Improvements
slide.blurb: *🗹* Add %EOF% for marking range from number to end-of-file:
Add %xdebug_add_source_map_directory()% function to dynamically add directories where will read mapping files from:
Come up with a better way to describe file/line ranges:

div.example: elephpant-list-1b6ba908.php:1-20 = elephpant-list.ezt:1 elephpant-list-1b6ba908.php:21-22 = elephpant-list.ezt:2 elephpant-list-1b6ba908.php:23 = elephpant-list.ezt:3 elephpant-list-1b6ba908.php:24-25 = elephpant-list.ezt:4
